about: Advisories the owner has looked at and accepted for now. The gate's dependency audit passes a HIGH finding only if it is listed here for that package path, signed (accepted_by is the owner's name, never PENDING OWNER; owner_words is what the owner typed; said_at is when) and not expired (review_by is today or later, and at most 30 days ahead). Only the owner signs an entry. What ships is checked separately, with no exceptions, by `npm audit --omit=dev` at moderate.

exceptions.why: picomatch is reached only through tinyglobby and fdir, which node-gyp and electron-builder use at BUILD time to match file names (node-gyp's two fixed patterns, build/*.sln and build/*.mk). No fix is published (docs/research/picomatch-ghsa.md, 4049ced). It is not in the app's production dependencies: `npm ls picomatch --omit=dev` shows (empty), checked 2026-11-18, so it is not in the installed app.
exceptions.accepted_by: Anfal Haider (owner), recorded by the Chief of Staff
exceptions.said_at: 2026-11-18, typed in the Chief of Staff's chat, answering "How should the build-tool advisory be handled?" (choices: Sign the exception / Wait for a fix)
